verdict.rationale: The 01 is built as a natural-language voice interface for computers. Its server processes spoken input and executes commands, including running code, browsing the web, managing files and controlling third-party software, and the Realtime API voice mode is documented. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably, documentation of non-voice (typed) natural-language input.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: it provides a natural language voice interface for computers
It processes input, executes commands, generates responses, and manages core logic using Open Interpreter.
Assistants powered by the 01 can execute code, browse the web, read and create files, control third-party software, and beyond.
You can talk to your 01 using OpenAI's Realtime API (Advanced Voice Mode) via the `--multimodel` flag
